question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_comp_ratio 
    FROM interest_metrics 
    WHERE month_year IN ('09-2018', '10-2018', '11-2018', '12-2018', '01-2019', '02-2019', '03-2019', '04-2019', '05-2019', '06-2019', '07-2019', '08-2019')
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_comp_ratio,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_comp_ratio DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_interests AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_comp_ratio, im.interest_name
    FROM ranked r
    JOIN interest_map im ON r.interest_id = im.id
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_name, avg_comp_ratio,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY 
               CASE month_year 
                   WHEN '09-2018' THEN 1 
                   WHEN '10-2018' THEN 2 
                   WHEN '11-2018' THEN 3 
                   WHEN '12-2018' THEN 4 
                   WHEN '01-2019' THEN 5 
                   WHEN '02-2019' THEN 6 
                   WHEN '03-2019' THEN 7 
                   WHEN '04-2019' THEN 8 
                   WHEN '05-2019' THEN 9 
                   WHEN '06-2019' THEN 10 
                   WHEN '07-2019' THEN 11 
                   WHEN '08-2019' THEN 12 
               END
           ) as row_num
    FROM top_interests
),
with_lag1 AS (
    SELECT *,
           LAG(interest_name) OVER (ORDER BY row_num) as prev_interest_name,
           LAG(avg_comp_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY row_num) as prev_max_composition
    FROM ordered
),
with_lag2 AS (
    SELECT *,
           LAG(interest_name) OVER (ORDER BY row_num) as prev2_interest_name,
           LAG(avg_comp_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY row_num) as prev2_max_composition
    FROM with_lag1
)
SELECT 
    month_year as date,
    interest_name,
    avg_comp_ratio as max_index_composition,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_comp_ratio) OVER (ORDER BY row_num ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 4) as rolling_avg,
    prev_interest_name,
    prev_max_composition,
    prev2_interest_name,
    prev2_max_composition
FROM with_lag2
ORDER BY row_num
